items.title: Tor amplitude over the base is detected on the localisations of the complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the tor amplitude of a complex of modules over one ring, computed over a smaller ring, can be tested after localising at the primes or even only the maximal ideals of the larger ring, and the proof is a 15-line argument for the substantive direction. It takes the cohomology of the derived tensor product against an arbitrary module, observes that it is a module over the larger ring whose localisations compute the cohomology of the localised complex against the localised module, and applies the criterion that a module is zero once all its localisations at maximal ideals are zero to conclude vanishing outside the interval. The author states explicitly that the two remaining implications between the three conditions are omitted, and that sentence is reproduced verbatim.
